entities.name: Buzzard's Bay

events.summary: In 3334 AR Emperor Johan of Tirras journeys to Buzzard's Bay seeking Shauku's famous library, finding only a small book shop.
events.quote: looking for the famous library of Shauku

events.summary: Johan tortures the location of Shauku's domain out of the bookseller Hebe and kills her.

relations.note: Johan killed the bookseller after torturing her.
